docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The second part of Rhys Davids’ Milinda: the remaining books of the dialogue of King Milinda and Nāgasena, with the index (Oxford, 1894). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Robarts Library, University of Toronto; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The questions of King Milinda · Davids, Thomas William Rhys, 1843-1922 · 1890-94, 438 scanned pages. Published 1890–1894; T. W. Rhys Davids died 1922; the text is ancient; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
